verdict.rationale: Bugbot's docs say it reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions. Cursor reports an 80% resolution rate even at high effort, and BUGBOT.md rules, org-wide rules and auto-learned rules let teams tune reviews. One community user calls its comments almost never frivolous, but another saw it repeat a reverted suggestion and turned off automatic reviews over verbose comment noise, a single anecdote that weakens rather than refutes the dedup claim. Missing for 10: any documented severity labels, independent measurement of false-positive rates, and evidence that dedup reliably prevents repeated suggestions.
